verdict.rationale: pnpm's own docs cover pinning both tools and packages per project. Tools: Node.js can be installed and pinned per project (pnpm-docs-4, pnpm-gh-2), and pnpm switches to the version named in `packageManager` or `devEngines.packageManager` (pnpm-docs-22), with runtime entries driven by `devEngines.runtime` (pnpm-docs-23). Packages: a lockfile is enforced in frozen mode in CI, and installs fail if it needs an update (pnpm-docs-13, pnpm-docs-34); checksums cannot change without an explicit opt-in (pnpm-docs-35); catalogs and overrides hold versions in one place (pnpm-docs-7, pnpm-docs-12). Missing for 10: no documented save-exact option for writing exact versions into package.json, and no independent hands-on corroboration that pins are respected in practice.
